name: hotel-restaurant-pos-monorepo
description: Fullstack Hotel & Restaurant POS, Kitchen Display System & Contactless QR Menu Platform

scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix server & npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.dev:server: lsof -ti:5001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.dev:client: lsof -ti:3002 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client

author: Antigravity
